## Proposed change
<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

Fixes #132844 by adding the "dghsxj" category to cameras. Some, mostly LSC Smart Connect, devices suddenly moved from sp to dghsxj, rendering them as "unsupported". (As discovered by @Neirop)

Most Tuya cameras are in the  device category "sp". About two months ago Tuya suddenly changed the category on some camera's, mostly of the LSC Smart Connect brand sold by Action stores in Europe, to "dghsxj".

It turns out "dghsxj" is a new, but still undocumented, category for "lower power consumption" cameras that Tuya moved some cameras too without any announcement whatsover. (Discoverd by @MPParsley)

> I contacted [LSC support](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lscsmartconnection.smart&hl=nl) to ask if they accidentally changed the category ID in the firmware.

I got the following answer from LSC support:

> "SP" is bedoeld voor standaard IPC, terwijl "DHGSXJ" specifiek wordt gebruikt voor camera's met een laag stroomverbruik. Het wijzigen van SP naar DHGSXJ heeft echter geen invloed op de functionaliteit of de gebruikerservaring.

In short:
1. The "DHGSXJ" category refers to (undocumented) low power consumption devices. Note that they respond with "DHGSXJ", not "DGHSXJ"
2. It works on the LSC app so it's not their problem (LSC doesn't support Home Assistant).

I think we can conclude that LSC did change the category in the firmware.
